name: Mist
summary: In Teldrassil's shaded boughs, Mist lies wounded and apart from her companion. She needs a safe path to Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak at a nearby moon well.

sections.title: A Wounded Companion
sections.body: Mist lies wounded in Teldrassil's undergrowth, her gray coat marked by deep slashes across her back and belly. Her blue eyes remain bright, and she stays calm instead of acting like a feral beast. She looks to friendly travelers for guidance and protection.

sections.title: The Price of Ambush
sections.body: Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak and Mist patrolled near the Oracle Tree when witches ambushed them and drove them apart. Arynia believed her beloved companion had died. Grieving, she withdrew to a nearby moon well and hoped Mist had survived.

faq.answer: Mist is Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak's loyal gray sabercat companion. Wounded in Teldrassil's forests, she was separated from Arynia in an ambush.
Witches in Teldrassil's woods ambushed Mist and Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak. They separated the pair and slashed Mist's back and belly.
Escort Mist safely to Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak, who waits beside a moon well near the Oracle Tree.
Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak is a night elf Sentinel and Mist's companion. She waits at a moon well near the Oracle Tree.

faq.q: Why are night elf Sentinels bonded with sabercats?
faq.answer: For millennia, night elf Sentinels have fought beside Kalimdor's great cats. Sabercats serve as fierce partners in skirmishes, scouts beneath shadowed boughs, and trusted lifelong companions.

faq.q: Where is the Oracle Tree in relation to this rescue?
faq.answer: The Oracle Tree stands in northwestern Teldrassil. A nearby moon well provides holy waters, and Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak tends to her duties there.

angles.text: As a night elf, you know Sentinels and sabercats share a bond central to your warfare and forest lore. Bringing Mist home honors that ancient companionship.
As a hunter, you recognize the fierce devotion in Mist's bright gaze. Her safe return to her companion is a matter of pride.
As an Alliance member, you can aid the Sentinels in Teldrassil and build goodwill with the kaldorei who defend the world tree.
